data.one_liner: Composable primitives for building accessible menu systems.
data.what_it_does: Provides headless primitive widgets like BaseMenu, BaseMenuBar, and BaseMenuItem to build custom, accessible menu systems with full WAI-ARIA keyboard support and menu aim assist. It manages keyboard traversal, focus routing, and menu positioning without painting any pixels itself.
use_when: You need to build a custom menu bar, context menu, or multi-level submenu system.
You require robust keyboard navigation following WAI-ARIA standards.
You want complete control over the visual styling of menus rather than relying on pre-styled components.
avoid_when: You prefer out-of-the-box material design menus that require minimal setup.
strengths: Completely headless, allowing fully customized styling and layout.
Built-in WAI-ARIA compliant keyboard support and focus routing.
Includes menu aim assist (safe triangles) for better hover interactions.
weaknesses: Requires manual implementation of visual styling and layouts since it provides no painted pixels out of the box.
API is relatively new and subject to change.
